# Feel Your Protocol — Website Documentation

> Agent-oriented documentation for the Feel Your Protocol **explorations website** —
> interactive, hands-on widgets for Ethereum protocol changes (EIPs, ERCs, research).
> Covers project structure, adding explorations, E-Components, styling, and video.
> Does **not** cover roadmap, community token, or MCP server development (see each
> folder's README in the GitHub repo).

Each exploration is a self-contained folder under `src/explorations/` with metadata
(`info.ts`) and an interactive widget (`MyC.vue`). Real Ethereum library code runs
in the browser.

Repo agent entrypoint: https://github.com/feelyourprotocol/website/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## Guide

- [Getting Started](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/guide/getting-started.html): Prerequisites, local setup, quality checks, website-only project layout
- [Architecture](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/guide/architecture.html): Folder-per-exploration model, taxonomies (Topics, Timeline, Tags), lazy-loaded widgets
- [Changelog](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/changelog.html): History of the structural base (contribution model, components, project structure)

## Contributing / automation

- [AI-Assisted Development](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/ai-assisted-development.html): Recommended agent workflow, prompts, and review checklist
- [Adding an Exploration](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/adding-an-exploration.html): Step-by-step from `info.ts` metadata to interactive widget and tests
- [How to Contribute](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/how-to-contribute.html): Where files live; quality gates before a PR
- [Images](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/images.html): Cover images and the color system
- [UI Components](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/ui-components.html): Shared UI primitives (e.g. ResultBoxUIC, example selectors)
- [E-Components](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/e-components.html): The reusable Ethereum building-block model
- [Available E-Components](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/available-e-components.html): Catalog of ready-to-use E-Components and their APIs
- [Styling & Design](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/styling.html): The exploration design system and class conventions
- [Code Conventions](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/code-conventions.html): Coding standards and test commands
- [Third-Party Libraries](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/third-party-libraries.html): How new library dependencies are evaluated and added
- [Video Pipeline](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/video-pipeline.html): Short-form exploration videos — architecture, overlays, recording
- [Authoring a Video Short](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/contributing/video-authoring.html): How to plan, write, and record exploration shorts

## Related (live sites, not dev docs here)

- [Main site](https://feelyourprotocol.org/): Live interactive explorations
- [All FYP docs (fleet hub)](https://docs.feelyourprotocol.org/): Entry card to website docs, MCP docs, roadmap, community token
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/feelyourprotocol/website): Monorepo — sibling-site READMEs for non-website dev work

## Notes

- Built with VitePress; Markdown sources live in `website-docs/` on GitHub.
- Beta: reusable component APIs may evolve. Latest docs always apply — no version switching.
- Educational, open-source software provided as-is; not affiliated with the Ethereum Foundation.
